states.loadFailed: Failed to load. Please try again later.
states.notAllowed: Your account is not allowed to view cash.
states.noStores: No stores are linked to your account. Ask an admin to add one.
states.noDepositPermission: Your account is not allowed to record deposits, select daily closes, or enter opening cash and cash counts.
states.noExpensePermission: Your account is not allowed to record cash expenses.

overview.formula: Cash on hand = opening + counted till cash from closes − deposits − expenses. The float is not included (taken out before counting), so after banking the balance should be close to $0.00.
overview.closeDisconnected: Daily close data is not connected yet, so cash on hand cannot be calculated. Deposits, expenses, records, opening cash and counts still work.
overview.openingMissing: No opening cash yet. Enter the opening cash first so cash on hand can be calculated.
overview.noSuggestion: Cash on hand is not positive, so there is no suggested deposit.
overview.suggestionUnavailable: Cash on hand cannot be calculated yet. Enter the deposit from your actual count.
overview.overdue: Cash from the oldest unbanked day is over {{days}} days old. Bank it as soon as possible.
overview.uncovered: Cash from {{count}} business day(s) hasn't been banked yet (earliest {{date}}, total {{amount}}).
overview.missingClose: {{count}} business day(s) in the last 14 days have no daily close (the store may have been closed): {{dates}}

daily.disconnected: Daily close data is not connected yet, so the daily breakdown is not available.
daily.empty: No daily close data in this period.
daily.noDevices: No device closes for this day.
daily.stale: A newer close was saved after this selection. Please confirm.
daily.overlap: The selected closes cover overlapping periods and may be counted twice.
daily.overlapLocal: The selected closes cover overlapping periods and may be counted twice. Please explain in the reason.
daily.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. AM and PM shifts each did a close; count both

errors.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for the selection (at least 2 characters).
errors.reasonTooLong: The reason is too long (500 characters at most).

void.reasonPlaceholder: At least 2 characters, e.g. wrong amount
void.reasonTooShort: The reason needs at least 2 characters.
void.reasonTooLong: The reason is too long (500 characters at most).
void.description: {{date}} · {{amount}}. Cash on hand will be adjusted and this cannot be undone.
void.entryDescription: {{type}} · {{date}} · {{amount}}. Cash on hand will be adjusted and this cannot be undone.

deposit.title: Bank deposit
deposit.baseline: Cash on hand is {{amount}}, which is also the suggested deposit (the float was taken out before counting).
deposit.baselineNoSuggestion: Cash on hand is {{amount}}, so there is no suggested deposit. A reason is required if the deposit total differs from it by more than {{threshold}}.
deposit.baselineUnavailable: Cash on hand could not be loaded, so there is no suggested deposit. The server will check the difference on submit.

fields.dateHintLimited: You can backdate up to {{days}} days (including today).
fields.dateHintUnlimited: You have access to all stores, so there's no backdating limit.

covered.title: Business days covered (optional)
covered.hint: Which business days' closing cash this deposit covers. By default from the oldest unbanked day to the latest day with a close. You can change or clear it.

slip.title: Slip {{index}}
slip.photosHint: 1 to {{max}} photos per slip. Make sure the amount and date are readable.

override.title: Reason for difference
override.hint: The deposit total differs from cash on hand by more than {{threshold}}. Please explain why.
override.label: Reason for difference (required)
override.placeholder: e.g. banked the float too / held back some cash

expense.title: Record cash expense
expense.effectiveNotice: Saved straight away, no approval needed. If you make a mistake, void it in Records and enter it again.

photos.receiptHint: Cash purchases need at least 1 receipt, up to {{max}}.
photos.optionalHint: You can attach up to {{max}} images.

balance.openingHint: Opening cash is the starting point for cash on hand: from the opening date, counted cash from closes is added and deposits and expenses are deducted. Each store can have only one active opening.
balance.countHint: Count the cash actually in the store (excluding the float) and compare it with the expected balance calculated by the system.
balance.differenceUnknown: Daily close data was not connected or there was no opening at that time, so the expected balance cannot be calculated and there is nothing to compare.

outcome.balanced: The count matches the expected balance.
outcome.over: The count is higher than expected. Check for unrecorded expenses or extra cash received.
outcome.short: The count is lower than expected. Check for unrecorded expenses or deposits.

balance.openingExists: This store already has an active opening cash entry. You can't enter another one.

detail.notFound: This record does not exist or you are not allowed to view it.
detail.created: Recorded. This is what the system saved.
detail.voidedBanner: This record was voided and no longer counts towards cash on hand.

photo.limitReached: At most {{max}} photos. The extra ones were ignored.

errors.decode_failed: This image cannot be processed. Choose another or take a new photo.
errors.blob_read_failed: Failed to read the image. Please try again.
errors.file_too_large: The image is still over 5 MB after compression. Choose another or take a new photo.
errors.libraryPermission: No photo library permission. Allow HB to access photos in system settings.

camera.full: {{max}}-photo limit reached. Tap Done to go back.
camera.captureFailed: Couldn't take that photo. Please try again.
camera.permissionDescription: The camera is needed to photograph deposit slips and receipts.

leave.discardMessage: What you entered and the photos you took will be lost.
leave.busyMessage: Please wait until the submission finishes before leaving, to avoid recording it twice.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.fixFirst: Please fix the fields marked in red first.
errors.uploadFailed: {{count}} photo(s) failed to upload. Tap Retry on the thumbnail or check your connection and submit again. Photos that already uploaded are not uploaded twice.
errors.retryKeepsData: Your entries and uploaded photos are kept. You can submit again and it will not be recorded twice.

money.notPositive: The amount must be greater than 0.

deposit.dateOutOfRange: The deposit date can't be in the future or earlier than the backdating limit.
deposit.coveredIncomplete: Fill in both the start and end of the covered days, or leave both empty.
deposit.coveredInvalid: The covered days are not valid dates.
deposit.coveredReversed: The covered start cannot be after the end.
deposit.coveredFuture: The covered days cannot be after the deposit date.
deposit.noteTooLong: The note is too long (500 characters at most).
deposit.slipPhotosMissing: Each slip needs at least 1 photo.
deposit.slipPhotosTooMany: Each slip can have at most {{max}} photos.
deposit.slipNoTooLong: The slip number is too long.
deposit.overrideReasonRequired: Enter the reason for the difference (at least 2 characters).

expense.dateOutOfRange: The expense date can't be in the future or earlier than the backdating limit.
expense.receiptRequired: Cash purchases need at least 1 receipt photo.
expense.payeeTooLong: The payee name is too long.
expense.noteTooLong: The note is too long (500 characters at most).

balance.dateOutOfRange: The date can't be in the future or earlier than the backdating limit.
balance.noteTooLong: The note is too long (500 characters at most).

codes.CASH_INVALID_REQUEST: The submitted data is not valid. Please check and try again.
codes.CASH_STORE_FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this store.
codes.CASH_RECORD_NOT_FOUND: This record does not exist or you are not allowed to view it.
codes.CASH_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The date is outside the allowed backdating range.
codes.CASH_ATTACHMENT_INVALID: An image is invalid or has expired. Submit again and the images will be uploaded again.
codes.CASH_OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED: The deposit total differs a lot from cash on hand. Enter the reason for the difference.
codes.CASH_OPENING_EXISTS: This store already has an active opening cash entry.
codes.CASH_VOID_NOT_ALLOWED: You are not allowed to void this record (without the void permission you can only void your own records within the time limit).
codes.CASH_CLOSE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Daily close data is not connected yet, so this is not available.
codes.CASH_CLOSE_NOT_FOUND: The selected daily close no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
codes.CASH_CONFLICT: The data was just changed. Refresh and try again.
